spec.claim_summary: Go long when the 5-period EMA crosses above the 50-period EMA and the 5-period RSI crosses above 50 on a closed candle.
assumptions: NOT EXPRESSIBLE: claim says '5ema crosses your 50ema and RSI cross the 50 line' without long/short or above/below direction; schema allows only long or short with crosses_above/crosses_below and no generic cross, so the closest testable core encodes the long side as crosses_above and the bearish/short side is omitted.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: claim states no exit rule; a testable spec requires an exit, so the opposite EMA cross was added as the closest testable core and is entirely assumed.
Timeframe chosen as 1d; claim mentions both daily and 4 hour charts and page context is 1d.
RSI setting is 5 and RSI trigger is 50, EMA lengths are 5 and 50 as stated; bar-close evaluation matches waiting for the candle to close.

evidence.quote: on USD/CAD, EUR/USD, GBP/USD, and also EUR/JPY
on the daily and 4 hour charts

audit_majors: direction: Claim says 5EMA crosses 50EMA and RSI crosses 50 with no long/short direction stated; spec encodes long-only crosses_above, omitting the symmetric bearish side and changing the signals tested.
exit[0]: Claim states no exit rule; spec invents opposite EMA cross (5EMA crosses_below 50EMA) as exit, which defines holding period and changes results.
